summary: Mendocino NF lookout in Lake County, built about 1915; the register says only the foundation of the original cabin remains; no source found on public access.

facts.design: 7x7 observation cabin on a 70-foot X-brace open steel tower; residence cabin also built; BC-201 cabin added 1935
facts.agency: US Forest Service, Mendocino National Forest
facts.status_note: The register says only the foundation of the original cabin remains today.

events.note: Spring water piped about 500 feet to the lookout, lifted by a salvaged gas engine into a 500-gallon tank (California Ranger, August 1941, as quoted by Forest Lookouts)

evidence.supports: 7x7 observation cabin on a 70-foot X-brace open steel tower
evidence.quote: Sheetiron Mountain was a 7x7 Observation only cabin on a 70 foot X-Brace open steel tower.
A residence cabin was also built.
A BC-201 Fireman-Lookout cabin was added in 1935.

evidence.supports: only the foundation of the original cabin remains today
evidence.quote: Only the foundation of the original cabin remains today.

evidence.supports: 1915 photograph from the Upper Lake Ranger District collection
evidence.quote: courtesy of Upper Lake Ranger District Collection

evidence.supports: Mendocino National Forest, Lake County lookout
elevation of 6,500 feet in the 1941 item
spring water through a 500-foot pipe line
evidence.quote: a stream of sparkling spring water running through a 500 foot pipe line

evidence.supports: salvaged gas engine helped push water uphill
item opens with Ranger John Monday

notes_for_editor: Only the register describes the site today, and that line is undated. No source read says whether the site is open to the public or how to reach it, so no access key is set; a Mendocino National Forest check would settle it. The height_m of 21.3 is the 70-foot tower converted to metres, taken as the structure height. The 1941 water-system item is quoted on the Forest Lookouts page, not read on the original newspaper. Leads not used: a UC Berkeley Library photo record for 'Lookout tower. Sheetiron Moutain, Lake County' (digicoll.lib.berkeley.edu/record/17033), which gave no date or text we could read, and a 2017 Mendocino NF social-media post with an unverified reader comment about a later use of the lookout; neither is cited. The record's Sheetiron entry has no height or access data, so height_m 21.3 is new.
